summary: Phase 2 verification: SWOT Save-as-Template backend (8/8 pytest passing) + UI flow end-to-end (modal opens, POST /api/swot/{id}/save-as-template returns 200 with factor_count=4, success alert shown). Discovered ONE significant bug: templates created via save-as-template store life_area_id as a raw human-readable string (e.g., 'Career') instead of the canonical taxonomy id (e.g., 'la_career'), which prevents them from surfacing in the /tools/new-decision template picker (which calls /api/hos/templates/suggest with life_area_id=la_*). SWOT flag chips rendering code in new-decision.tsx is correct but COULD NOT be visually validated because the picker returns 0 templates for module=swot due to the life_area_id mismatch above. Regressions for /tools/add-solution, /prr/new render fine with back+home headers.

critical.issue: life_area_id is set from swot.get('life_area') (a free-text label like 'Career') instead of the canonical taxonomy id (la_career). This breaks discoverability via /api/hos/templates/suggest?life_area_id=la_*&module=swot. Fix at /app/backend/routes/swot.py:265 — either look up the taxonomy id from the SWOT analysis (it should already store life_area_id), or look up swot_analyses.life_area_id and use it directly. Also consider falling back to empty (which behaves as wildcard) instead of leaking the raw label.

minor.issue: When module=swot is passed, no SWOT-saved templates surface because (a) life_area_id mismatch above, AND (b) it's unclear whether suggest filters by applies_to_modules. Even with empty life_area_id, our admin-saved templates (life_area_id='') did not surface. Recommend confirming the suggest query honors applies_to_modules contains 'swot' OR template_type='AUTHORIZED_STANDARD' with empty life_area as wildcard.

integration_issues.issue: Picker calls /api/hos/templates/suggest with module=swot and returns 0 templates even when SWOT templates exist in DB. Root cause is backend bug above (life_area_id stored as 'Career' rather than 'la_career'). SWOT flag chip rendering (S/W/O/T color-coded chips on template cards) cannot be visually verified end-to-end until backend bug is fixed.

action_items: FIX backend/routes/swot.py:265: use swot.get('life_area_id') (canonical id) instead of swot.get('life_area') (label). If SWOT analyses don't carry life_area_id, look it up by name in life_areas collection or leave it empty so it's wildcard.
VERIFY /api/hos/templates/suggest correctly surfaces docs where applies_to_modules contains 'swot' (currently returns 0 for module=swot even though hos_decision_templates has 25 such docs).

After backend fix, re-run a UI walkthrough of /tools/new-decision?module=swot to visually confirm S/W/O/T color-coded chips render on template cards (code at new-decision.tsx:625–665 looks correct, just couldn't be exercised).

Add testID attributes to SWOT detail buttons: save-as-template-button, save-template-submit, template-name-input, template-description-input, is-public-toggle — currently tests rely on text matching which is brittle.
Consider adding goHome button (with safeBack already present) to SWOT detail header for parity with list view (only list view shows Home icon).
critical_code_review_comments: swot.tsx is 1148 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting the modal components (Add Item Modal, Save Template Modal) into separate files.
Save Template modal in swot.tsx lacks testID on its core inputs/buttons; tests had to use text matching with .first selectors.
swot.py save-as-template handler does not validate that user-provided name is unique per user — duplicate templates with identical titles can be silently created.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 pytest passing for save-as-template validation, response shape, factor derivation, admin vs non-admin path, discoverability via /hos/templates list)
success_rate.frontend: ~70% (SWOT list, detail, Save-as-Template modal & POST all working; new-decision template picker chips couldn't be visually verified due to backend taxonomy bug)

(4) Use the test creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md for non-admin path (harden_1777921741@example.com).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/backend/routes/swot.py line 265 sets `life_area_id` to `swot.get('life_area')` which returns the human-readable label string (e.g., 'Career'), not the canonical taxonomy id (e.g., 'la_career'). The /api/hos/templates/suggest endpoint filters by life_area_id strictly. Repro: POST /api/swot to create SWOT with life_area='Career', fill items, POST save-as-template → inspect template doc → life_area_id='Career' (raw) instead of 'la_career'. Mitigation: change line 265 to `swot.get('life_area_id') or ''` (the SWOT analysis likely already stores canonical id) OR resolve the label to id via a lookup in life_areas collection.
